defects.description: Forearms not on railing. Description: "Rest both forearms on the railing". Currently shoulderFwdL=-1, shoulderFwdR=-5 (near-zero forward flexion) — arms hang at sides, not reaching forward to railing. Wrists at z=+0.207/+0.123 (slightly forward) and y=0.043/-0.048 (hip level). For forearm-on-railing, wrists should be forward of elbows (z+) and at same height as elbows (forearm horizontal). Currently elbows at y=0.328/0.276 (above wrists) — forearm angled DOWN, not horizontal.

leftElbow/rightElbow config=81° but derived elbow_flexion_deg=42°/23° — elbows not bent enough for forearm-horizontal-on-railing pose. Forearm angle (forearm_forward_deg) is only 29°/12° — arms mostly straight down.

failing_tests.expected: wrist forward of elbow by 0.15+ (forearm extends forward to railing)
failing_tests.actual: wrist z=0.207 vs elbow z=0.047 (diff 0.16, barely forward)

failing_tests.expected: wrist within 5cm of elbow height (forearm horizontal)
failing_tests.actual: wrist y=0.043 vs elbow y=0.328 (wrist 0.29m below elbow — forearm angled down)

regression_risk: low — 4 fields, single-pose. Both shoulders swing forward to reach railing; both elbows bend more for forearm-horizontal rest. spine:14 preserved (rounding back forward ✓). hipAbductL:+10, hipAbductR:-10 preserved (legs crossed at ankle, PR-v5 convention-correct for crossed stance). rationale: CORRECTED CONVENTION: shoulderFwdL/R - = FORWARD. Description: "Rest both forearms on the railing, rounding the back gently forward". Arms must reach FORWARD to railing (shoulderFwd negative). Currently shoulderFwdL/R=-1/-5 (near-zero) — arms hang at sides. Setting -25 swings upper arms forward to reach railing. leftElbow/rightElbow:81→100 increases bend so forearms fold to horizontal on railing surface (typical lean-on-railing pose has ~90-100° elbow bend with forearm flat). spine:14 (forward) preserved — matches "rounding the back gently forward". PR-v3 correctly flipped spine from -14 to +14 (was a true positive for this pose). hipAbductL:+10, hipAbductR:-10 preserved (legs crossed, geometry verified: left hip_abduction_deg=-15 inward, right +15 outward — opposite signs = crossed).
